angle: Breaks down what 'per hire' pay really means across agency/contingency, retained, RPO, and in-house recruiters, with real commission percentages and dollar ranges by role and seniority from public salary and industry-fee data, answering the recruiter's-own-earnings question the keyword actually asks instead of restating employer cost-per-hire.  [spoke keyword: 'how much do recruiters make per hire']

Commission models walked through in detail
Compensation-model comparison: salary+bonus vs. base+commission vs. pure commission
Executive search recruiter pay ($110k-$300k+, highest commissions)
In-house recruiter pay broken out separately
Top-paying industries for recruiters (IT/Tech, Financial Services, Legal, Pharma/Biotech)
